official_sources.verified_fact: GeoJSON coordinates use WGS84/CRS84 longitude and latitude in decimal degrees; the standard does not provide an observation epoch or ETRS89 equivalence.
official_sources.limitation: RFC7946 labelling alone cannot authorize an ETRS89-to-BNG transformation at parcel accuracy.

official_sources.verified_fact: ETRS89 coincided with WGS84 at epoch 1989.0 and then remained fixed to the Eurasian plate while WGS84 continued to evolve.
official_sources.limitation: A bare WGS84 label does not disclose the realisation or observation epoch needed to establish equivalence.

official_sources.verified_fact: ITRS coordinates must be propagated to the epoch of observation before transformation into an ETRS89 frame.
official_sources.limitation: Commit or file creation timestamps are not coordinate observation epochs.

official_sources.verified_fact: OS documents ETRS89 EPSG:4258 and WGS84 EPSG:4326 as distinct selectable coordinate reference systems.
official_sources.limitation: Axis order and datum labels do not prove the source coordinate lineage.

official_sources.verified_fact: OSTN15 is the definitive ETRS89-to-OSGB36 transformation and uses one-kilometre grids with bilinear interpolation; simple Helmert transformations are only metre-level approximations.
official_sources.limitation: OSTN15 can only be selected after the source coordinates are accepted as ETRS89 or transformed to it with evidence.

official_sources.verified_fact: EPSG operation 7953 is the OSNet v2009 ETRS89 to British National Grid transformation adopted as the official OSGB36 definition from August 2016.
official_sources.limitation: The runtime must verify area of use, selected operation and required grid availability.

official_sources.verified_fact: EPSG operation 7711 identifies the OSNet v2009 ETRS89-to-ODN height operation and its OSTN15/OSGM15 model file lineage.
official_sources.limitation: Model identity does not replace validation of the selected EA raster vertical datum and survey metadata.

official_sources.verified_fact: PROJ exposes grid availability when selecting coordinate operations; ONLY_BEST behavior can reject execution when the best known transformation cannot be used.
official_sources.limitation: The runner must record PROJ/pyproj versions, selected operation text and actual grid availability.
